narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The shapes look different, but the same area means the same perimeter.
<bookmark mark='sides'/>Look at the slanting sides of the most leaning one and the upright one.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The leaning sides are much longer, so the distance around cannot be the same.

narration: <bookmark mark='c1'/>To check the areas, count the squares in two of them, cutting and moving the half squares.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>To check the perimeters, measure the slanting sides with a ruler and compare.
